content: I wish I could show you when you are lonely or in darkness the astonishing light of your own being.
author: Hafez
explanation: When enveloped in despair or isolation, our ego-mind forgets its transcendent nature. Hafez acts as the ecstatic mystic reminding us that beneath the transient clouds of sorrow, our essential consciousness is indestructible divine radiance.
practicalInsight: When feeling insecure or down today, place a hand over your heart, close your eyes, and remember the quiet light residing within your breath.
reflectionPrompt: If you truly recognized the luminous worth of your own being, what petty anxieties would instantly evaporate?
